items.title: Chevron's big bet: Why its $7B Venezuelan oil investment makes sense
items.summary: Chevron (CVX) will invest $7 billion in Venezuela over the next five years to double its crude oil (CL=F, BZ=F) production there. This comes just days after the US entered a major oil deal with Venezuela, buying up a large portion of the country's oil production rights. Morning Brief host Julie Hyman discusses the details with Politico senior reporter Sam Sutton and Semafor business reporter Rohan Goswami.

items.title: Coinbase tokenized stocks hit $100M in volume; first Zcash ETF and Strategy yield goes DeFi
items.summary: On this episode of CoinDesk's Public Keys from the New York Stock Exchange, host Jennifer Sanasie is joined by Ben Spiegelman, Head of Institutional at Base, to break down Coinbase's newly launched tokenized stocks. Zach Pandl, Head of Research at Grayscale, unpacks the debut of the first-ever Zcash ETF.
